title: Supplementary data on rapid sample clean-up procedure of aminophosphonates for LC/MS analysis
author: Kuhn, Bryant, et al.

steps.title: Conventional: Prepare filtration unit
steps.instruction: Set up the vacuum filtration assembly with the Dowex resin.

substeps.instruction: Set a 6 mL bond elution reservoir in the vacuum filtration unit.
Fit the reservoir with a frit at the bottom.
Fill the reservoir with homogenised wet Dowex 50WX8 corresponding to 1.75 g wet resin material.
Cover the resin with the frit.

steps.title: Conventional: Rinse resin bed
steps.instruction: Remove any residual contaminants from the cation‑exchange resin.

substeps.instruction: Rinse the CER (cation‑exchange resin) bed with 20 mL ultrapure water (UPW).

steps.title: Conventional: Load sample
steps.instruction: Apply the phosphonate‑containing sample to the resin.

substeps.instruction: Load 4 mL standard sample solution containing phosphonates such as AMPA onto the resin.

steps.title: Conventional: Elute and collect
steps.instruction: Recover the purified analyte for LC/MS analysis.

substeps.instruction: Elute the sample at a flow rate of 1 mL min⁻¹.
Discard the initial 2 mL of eluent.
Collect the final 2 mL of eluent.
Use the purified sample for analysis.

steps.title: Optimized: Prepare filtration unit
steps.instruction: Set up the vacuum filtration assembly with the Dowex resin for the improved protocol.

substeps.instruction: Set a 6 mL bond elution reservoir in the vacuum filtration unit.
Fit the reservoir with a frit at the bottom.
Fill the reservoir with homogenised wet Dowex 50WX8 corresponding to 1.75 g wet resin material.
Cover the resin with the frit.

steps.title: Optimized: Rinse resin bed
steps.instruction: Remove residual contaminants from the resin before sample loading.

substeps.instruction: Rinse the CER bed with 20 mL ultrapure water (UPW).

steps.title: Optimized: Load and pre‑elute
steps.instruction: Introduce the sample and perform a pre‑elution while keeping the resin bed covered.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL standard sample solution containing phosphonates such as AMPA.
Elute with a flow rate of 1 mL min⁻¹ until the CER column bed remains covered.
Discard the eluent (approximately 2 mL).

steps.title: Optimized: Incubate and final elution
steps.instruction: Prevent AMPA exchange and collect the purified sample.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the CER bed for 1 min to prevent AMPA exchange against hydrogen ions.
Add 4 mL standard solution onto the CER bed.
Elute the solution and discard the initial 2 mL.
Continue elution and collect the final 2 mL for analysis.
